title: Effect of learning management system on Student’s performance in educational measurement and evaluation
reason: Non-equivalent-group quasi-experiment comparing achievement-test scores (ANCOVA) of students taught with Moodle vs a CAI package, plus gender contrasts. No per-student platform indicator or activity product enters any analysis.
